remarks:
Completely redesigned and reimagined in 2021, this exceptional property is an established vacation rental with a proven rental history, offering a rare combination of privacy, natural beauty, and convenience. Tucked away on more than 4 wooded acres overlooking the Chautauqua Gorge, you'll feel miles away from it all while being just minutes from the shops, restaurants, and conveniences of Westfield's Main Street. Spend your days exploring private trails, fishing or wading in the creek, relaxing in one of the hammocks beneath the trees, or gathering around the fire pit while enjoying the peaceful sounds of the flowing water.

Inside, nearly every room takes advantage of the surrounding woodland and gorge views. The main level features an open-concept kitchen, dining area, and living room with access to a spacious balcony overlooking the gorge. The primary suite also opens directly to the balcony and includes a beautifully appointed ensuite bath. A half bath with laundry area completes the main level.

The walkout lower level offers plenty of space for family and guests with a family room and game area, two additional bedrooms, one with direct access to the covered lower deck, and a full bathroom.

Whether you're searching for a full-time residence, a private getaway, or an established income-producing investment, this property is being offered fully furnished and offers exceptional flexibility. It offers a rare opportunity to own a private retreat in one of Chautauqua County's most unique natural settings.
